set.body: Introduce a canonical VoxelRegion carrying VolumeSpace plus validated membership, and separate unordered membership from stable extraction order. Implement checked union, intersection, difference, xor, complement, and NeuroVol or NeuroVec selection. Keep ROICoords as an explicit legacy adapter. Add cross-space rejection tests.
set.title: Image pipeline 1: space-bound VoxelRegion and selection algebra
